questions.title: Azure OpenAI Service Access
questions.scenario: A fintech startup needs to integrate GPT-4 capabilities into their customer service platform and needs to identify which Azure service provides REST API access to OpenAI models with enterprise security features.

questions.title: Prompt Engineering Fundamentals
questions.scenario: A customer support team wants to improve chatbot response quality without retraining models. They need guidance on designing and refining text input to guide model output toward accurate and relevant responses.

questions.title: Machine Learning Model Development
questions.scenario: A healthcare organization needs to build, train, and deploy custom ML models for patient risk prediction. They require a managed platform that handles the entire ML lifecycle from experimentation to production.

questions.title: Embedding Vectors
questions.scenario: A search startup wants to enable semantic similarity matching between user queries and product documents. They need to understand how to represent text meaning as numeric vectors for comparison.

questions.title: Vector Search Infrastructure
questions.scenario: An e-commerce platform needs to store millions of product embeddings and enable fast similarity searches. They are evaluating Azure services that can handle vector indexing and retrieval at scale.

questions.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
questions.scenario: A legal tech company wants to build a Q&A system over confidential contracts without fine-tuning the model. They need to combine document retrieval with generative AI to ground answers in specific contract clauses.

questions.title: AI Model Hallucinations
questions.scenario: A medical AI system occasionally generates confident-sounding but factually incorrect diagnoses. The team needs to understand this failure mode and implement mitigations.

questions.title: Output Randomness Control
questions.scenario: A banking application needs deterministic responses for loan eligibility decisions while a creative writing feature needs variety. Engineers need to control the randomness parameter for different use cases.

questions.title: Grounding for Factuality
questions.scenario: A news organization building an AI editor wants to eliminate fabricated facts in generated articles. They need the most effective practice for ensuring AI-generated content is anchored to verified sources.

questions.title: Secret and Key Management
questions.scenario: A SaaS platform integrating Azure OpenAI for multiple customers needs a secure way to store API keys and database credentials without hardcoding them in the codebase.

questions.title: System Observability
questions.scenario: A production AI system shows intermittent errors that are hard to diagnose. The team needs comprehensive visibility into metrics, logs, and traces across Azure services to identify bottlenecks.

questions.title: Response Length Limitation
questions.scenario: An API endpoint serving summarization needs to cap response size to prevent timeout issues and control token usage costs. Operators need to enforce a maximum output length.

questions.title: Prompt Injection Attacks
questions.scenario: A customer-facing AI chatbot is tricked by malicious users into ignoring safety instructions. Security teams need to understand this attack vector and implement defense layers.

questions.title: Cost-Efficient Model Selection
questions.scenario: A startup's Azure OpenAI bill is 10x higher than planned. The engineering team needs to identify how to choose the right model tier for each task to optimize spending without sacrificing quality.

questions.title: Workflow Orchestration
questions.scenario: A document processing pipeline requires sequential steps: upload, OCR, AI analysis, and database storage. Teams need a low-code platform to coordinate these distributed tasks without complex coding.

questions.title: Evaluation Dataset Design
questions.scenario: An AI engineering team struggles to objectively measure whether prompt improvements actually enhance quality. They need a systematic way to benchmark changes across consistent test cases.

questions.title: Fallback and Reliability
questions.scenario: A mission-critical AI application in a hospital must maintain high availability even during Azure OpenAI service disruptions. The team needs strategies to ensure graceful degradation.

questions.title: Response Caching Benefits
questions.scenario: A chatbot platform serves thousands of users asking the same questions repeatedly. The team wants to reduce API calls and improve response speed for frequent queries without code changes.

questions.title: Latency Contributors
questions.scenario: A real-time chat application feels sluggish. Performance engineers need to isolate which factors most impact response time: model choice, prompt length, output size, or infrastructure.

questions.title: Output Safety Guardrails
questions.scenario: An AI customer service system occasionally generates responses that violate company policies or harm brand reputation. Risk managers need safety mechanisms to constrain model behavior.

questions.title: Cost Factors in AI APIs
questions.scenario: Product managers need to estimate total cost of ownership for a planned AI feature before launching. Understanding which factors drive billing is critical for accurate financial projections.

questions.title: Streaming Response Benefits
questions.scenario: A web-based AI assistant feels unresponsive to users who must wait for complete responses. The team wants to improve perceived performance by showing responses as they are generated.

questions.title: Observability Best Practices
questions.scenario: An AI platform lacks visibility into why some requests fail or become slow. Teams need to implement structured data collection that enables root-cause analysis and alerting.

questions.title: Human Review in AI Workflows
questions.scenario: A legal contract analysis system must ensure accuracy before providing advice to clients. Organizations need to embed human validation steps at critical decision points in automated workflows.

questions.title: AI Engineering Goals
questions.scenario: An organization is building its first production AI system and needs clarity on success criteria beyond just model accuracy. What should engineers optimize for in enterprise deployments?

questions.title: Container Deployment for AI
questions.scenario: A research team has custom AI model inference code that does not fit Azure managed endpoints. They need a platform to deploy containerized applications with GPU support and auto-scaling.

questions.title: API Gateway for AI Services
questions.scenario: A multi-tenant AI platform must enforce rate limits per customer, load-balance across regions, and audit all requests for compliance. A central gateway is needed to manage these concerns.

questions.title: Access Control and Authorization
questions.scenario: A research organization needs different permissions for data scientists, ML engineers, and application developers. They need fine-grained access control over Azure AI resources.

questions.title: Fine-Tuning for Domain Adaptation
questions.scenario: A legal document classification system achieves 75% accuracy with generic prompts. The team wants to adapt a foundation model to legal terminology and case law for higher accuracy.

questions.title: Token Count Optimization
questions.scenario: A RAG system injecting full documents into prompts consumes 5000+ tokens per request, driving costs up. The team needs strategies to shrink context size while preserving answer quality.

questions.title: Serverless Event-Driven Compute
questions.scenario: A content moderation pipeline needs to trigger AI analysis whenever new files upload to cloud storage. Engineers need lightweight, scalable compute that activates only when needed.

questions.title: Nucleus Sampling
questions.scenario: An AI model's responses are either too repetitive or too random. The team wants a more sophisticated sampling method that adapts token selection based on model confidence.

questions.title: Multi-Region System Resilience
questions.scenario: A global AI service experienced a regional outage last week, causing customer impact. The team needs to design for geographic redundancy and automatic failover.

questions.title: Data Storage for AI Pipelines
questions.scenario: An AI platform needs to store terabytes of raw documents, training data, and logs across multiple processing stages. They need scalable, cost-effective unstructured data storage.

questions.title: Sequential Prompt Chaining
questions.scenario: A document analysis system struggles with complex reasoning in a single prompt. Breaking the task into simpler sequential steps could improve quality and debuggability.

questions.title: Data Quality Impact
questions.scenario: A classification model has low accuracy, but nobody knows why. The team suspects the root cause is not the model itself but the quality and relevance of training examples.

questions.title: Experiment Tracking Systems
questions.scenario: A team experimenting with different prompts and models has no clear record of which parameters produced the best results. They need systematic tracking to guide optimization decisions.

questions.title: Response Time Measurement
questions.scenario: A customer complains that the AI chatbot is slow. Performance teams need to measure exactly how much time elapses between user input and response delivery.

questions.title: Secure Credential Management
questions.scenario: An Azure Function calling Azure OpenAI currently stores credentials in environment variables, creating security risks. The team needs automatic credential rotation without code changes.

questions.title: Batch Processing Inference
questions.scenario: A company needs to generate summaries for 10 million archived documents overnight. Real-time endpoints are overkill; they need high-throughput, cost-effective batch processing.

questions.title: Real-time Inference Serving
questions.scenario: A mobile app needs immediate AI predictions when users take photos. The backend must deliver responses within 500ms to keep the UX responsive.

questions.title: Model Tier Right-sizing
questions.scenario: A company has 50% of requests going to a complex reasoning model for tasks a cheaper model could handle. Switching simpler queries could cut costs significantly.

questions.title: Model Drift Detection
questions.scenario: An AI system built 6 months ago is showing degraded accuracy in production. Market changes, new terminology, and updated policies have shifted the real-world data distribution.

questions.title: Drift Mitigation Strategies
questions.scenario: After detecting that an AI model's accuracy is declining, teams need to understand how to systematically refresh the model or knowledge base to restore performance.

questions.title: CI/CD for AI Systems
questions.scenario: An AI team wants to push prompt improvements to production without manual testing steps that slow releases. Automated pipelines should test and deploy safe changes continuously.

questions.title: Text Tokenization Process
questions.scenario: An engineer notices their prompt uses far more tokens than expected and is concerned about billing accuracy. Understanding how text breaks down into tokens is critical for budgeting.

questions.title: User Experience Enhancement
questions.scenario: A chat interface feels unresponsive despite adequate backend latency because users see blank screens waiting for responses. A UI improvement could dramatically improve perceived performance.

questions.title: Context Window Management
questions.scenario: A multi-turn conversation system loses memory of earlier exchanges once context becomes too long. Teams need strategies for managing conversation history without hitting token limits.

questions.title: Privacy-Preserving AI
questions.scenario: A healthcare provider wants to use Azure OpenAI for clinical note analysis without sending sensitive patient data to shared cloud infrastructure. They need solutions that keep data private.

questions.title: Cost Monitoring and Optimization
questions.scenario: An AI platform's monthly spending is growing unpredictably, making it hard to budget. The team needs tools to track per-request costs, identify high-spending features, and project future expenses.
